_notes: build: run from gateway/, builds the workspace's release binary and copies it to the runner's {out}. CSGATEWAY_BIN=<repo>/target/release/cs-gateway skips it.
upstream_env: the same variables as Go (the Rust gateway reads Go's environment contract unchanged).
ca_env: rustls with native roots honours SSL_CERT_FILE on every platform (no GODEBUG equivalent is needed).
disable_endpoints: none. vllm-spark2 is not compiled in (G5 moved it to a host overlay file), so nothing local needs guarding.
